title: Let's Light Up Greenway Trail
passage_text:
Dear Neighbors of the Maple Hollow community,

If you walk your dog, push a stroller, or ride your bike after dinner, you have probably noticed how dark Greenway Trail becomes once the sun goes down. I am a sixth grader who uses the trail every day, and I am writing to ask you to sign our petition for solar lights along the path.

Many of you have told me at our block parties that you stopped walking the trail in the evening because you cannot see roots, puddles, or cyclists coming toward you. Last winter, two people in our neighborhood twisted their ankles on the uneven section near the creek. Better lighting would make the trail safer for everyone who lives here, from toddlers to grandparents.

Some of you may worry about the cost, since our homeowners association has a tight budget this year. The good news is that solar lights do not need electrical wiring, and the city parks department has offered to pay for half of them through its community grant program.

Others may wonder whether bright lights will shine into backyards and keep families awake. The lights we have chosen point down toward the path and turn off automatically at eleven o'clock.

You know this neighborhood better than anyone, and your signatures will show the city that we care about the trail we share. Please sign the petition at the community mailbox or online before our meeting on March 3. Together we can make Greenway Trail a place where every neighbor feels safe after dark.

Sincerely,
Nadia Herrera
